newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil finds Garden Banks 161 oil.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil finds Garden Banks 161 oil.

text.p: Pennzoil Co said Monday its partnership with Enterprise Oil Plc found more than 220 feet of potentially productive oil sands in the Garden Banks 161 No. 1 well.
Garden Banks Block 161, lociated in the Gulf of Mexico, about 130 miles offshore Louisians in 975 feet of water, is operated by Pennzoil, the company said.

Pennzoil obtained a 100 percent working interest in the block through a farm-in from Exxon Corp, which retains a right to "back in" -- acquire an interest by paying a portion of the costs, Pennzoil spokesman Gregt Panagos said.
Noting the potentially productive sand logged in three separate intervals, he said the well is "potentially a very attractive find."
Pennzoil said it has completed drilling to the target depth of 18,000 feet, adding the well will not be flow tested, but will be suspended for future development purposes.
Development scenarios and future appraisal wells for the Garden Banks 161 block and the adjoining Garden Banks 162 block are being evaluated with Enterprise, Pennzoil said.

It noted the companies formed a strategic alliance in September to jointly explore prospects on 102 of Pennzoil's leases in the Gulf of Mexico where the company's working interest is 50 percent or more.

Enterprise will earn an interest equal to half of Pennzoil's working interest in each prospect by contributing funds towards the costs of drilling a jointly-agreed upon exploration well on each prospect.
